property_summary: If C.transfer returns (i.e., does not revert) then it returns true and it made an external call to the target contract for each provided recipient, so the function returns true exactly when it completes the loop without reverting.
For any valid inputs that satisfy C.transfer preconditions, a non-reverting call to C.transfer always returns true (it never returns false).
If transfer is called with valid inputs and does not revert, it returns true (i.e., non-reverting calls return true).
